name: Penne with Creamy Ricotta-Marinara Sauce, Kale, Mushrooms & Basil

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g penne pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel, halve, and small dice onions. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, mushrooms, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 (227g ) pkg sliced white mushrooms
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are done, add kale to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (283 g) bags kale, cut and ready to use

instructions.primary_message: Add marinara sauce and ricotta to the pot. Stir to combine and bring the sauce to a simmer over medium heat. Once simmering, remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (680 g) jars marinara sauce
1 ½ (425 g) pkgs ricotta cheese

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, and pick basil leaves off the stems; roll up crosswise and thinly slice into ribbons. Add half to the pot with the sauce and stir to combine. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
When the pasta is done, drain and add to the pot with the sauce. Stir to coat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls and sprinkle with reserved basil. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: kale, cut and ready to use
